usage: Parses Windows shortcut (.lnk) files, showing the target path, timestamps, volume and machine details. Use it to find which files and devices a user opened or accessed.
limitation: A shortcut records the target as it was when opened. Shortcuts can be deleted, and the target may have changed or gone since.

parameters.label: LNK file
parameters.description: File to process. Either this or -d is required.

parameters.label: Directory
parameters.description: Directory to recursively process. Either this or -f is required.

parameters.label: Removable drives only
parameters.description: Only process lnk files pointing to removable drives.

parameters.label: All files
parameters.description: Process all files in directory vs. only files matching *.lnk.

parameters.label: Suppress Target ID list
parameters.description: Suppress Target ID list details from being displayed.

parameters.label: Suppress extra blocks
parameters.description: Suppress Extra blocks information from being displayed.
